GET /system_performance/_search

POST /crtdataindex/_update_by_query
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
        "must_not": {
            "exists": {
                "field": "MinimumNumberOfMeasurements"
            }
        }
    }
  },
  "script" : {
    "inline": "ctx._source['MinimumNumberOfMeasurements']= ctx._source.MinimumNumberOfMeasurement; ctx._source.remove(\"MinimumNumberOfMeasurement\");"
  }
}
POST /crtdataindex1809/_update_by_query
{
  "query" : {
        "exists": { "field": "MinimumNumberOfMeasurements.keyword"}},
  "script" : {
    "inline": "ctx._source.remove(\"MinimumNumberOfMeasurements.keyword\")"
  }
}

POST crtdataindex1809/_update_by_query?conflicts=proceed
{
    "script" : "ctx._source.MinimumNumberOfMeasurements.remove('keyword')",
    "query" : {
        "exists": { "field": "MinimumNumberOfMeasurements.keyword" }
    }
}

POST _reindex
{  
  "source": {    "index": "issuedebug"  },
  "dest": {    "index": "system_performance"  }
}
